name: elementor-mcp-list-widgets
description: Returns all registered Elementor widget types with their names, titles, icons, categories, and keywords. Optionally filter by widget category.

name: elementor-mcp-get-widget-schema
description: Returns the full JSON Schema for a widget type's settings, describing all available controls and their types. Use this to discover what settings a widget accepts before creating or updating it.

name: elementor-mcp-get-container-schema
description: Returns JSON Schema for all container controls (flex + grid), including flex_direction, justify_content, align_items, flex_wrap, gap, content_width, min_height, container_type, grid controls, background, border, padding, and more.

name: elementor-mcp-get-page-structure
description: Returns the element tree for an Elementor page, showing all containers, widgets, and their nesting structure. Each element includes its ID, type, widget type (for widgets), and child elements.

name: elementor-mcp-get-element-settings
description: Returns the current settings for a specific element on a page. Provide the post ID and element ID to retrieve all control values for that element.

name: elementor-mcp-find-element
description: Searches elements on a page by type, widget type, or settings content. Returns matching element IDs, types, and a settings preview.

widget_type.description: Filter by widget type (e.g. "heading", "button"). Leave empty for all.

search_text.description: Search for text content in settings values (case-insensitive).

name: elementor-mcp-list-pages
description: Returns all WordPress pages and posts that are built with Elementor. Optionally filter by post type and status.

post_type.description: Filter by post type (e.g. "page", "post"). Default: any.

status.description: Filter by post status (e.g. "publish", "draft"). Default: any.

name: elementor-mcp-list-templates
description: Returns all saved Elementor templates from the template library. Optionally filter by template type (page, section, container).

name: elementor-mcp-get-global-settings
description: Returns the active Elementor kit/global settings including colors, typography, spacing, and breakpoints. These are the site-wide design tokens used across all pages.

name: elementor-mcp-create-page
description: Creates a new WordPress page with Elementor enabled. Optionally provide initial element content.

name: elementor-mcp-update-page-settings
description: Updates page-level Elementor settings such as background, padding, custom CSS, and layout options.

name: elementor-mcp-delete-page-content
description: Clears all Elementor content from a page, resetting it to blank while keeping the page itself.

name: elementor-mcp-import-template
description: Imports a JSON template structure into a page at an optional position.

template_json.description: Elementor JSON element structure to import.

name: elementor-mcp-export-page
description: Exports a page's full Elementor data as a JSON structure that can be imported elsewhere.

name: elementor-mcp-add-container
description: Adds a container to a page. Supports both flex (default) and grid layouts via container_type. Omit parent_id for top-level, or provide a parent container ID for nesting. Flex tips: Use flex_direction=row for side-by-side children, flex_wrap=wrap for wrapping, flex_justify_content for main-axis alignment (e.g. space-between, center), flex_align_items for cross-axis alignment. (The shorthand justify_content / align_items are also accepted and remapped to flex_justify_content / flex_align_items.) Grid tips: Set container_type=grid with grid_columns_grid, grid_rows_grid, grid_gaps. Background: set background_background=classic and background_color=#hex. Border: set border_border=solid, border_width, border_color. Also supports min_height, overflow, html_tag, padding, margin, position, z_index, animation.

parent_id.description: Parent container ID for nesting. Omit for top-level.

settings.description: Container settings: flex_direction, flex_wrap, flex_justify_content, flex_align_items, gap, content_width, padding, margin, background, border, etc. (Unprefixed justify_content / align_items / align_content are accepted and remapped to the flex_-prefixed keys.)

name: elementor-mcp-update-container
description: Updates settings on an existing container. Settings are merged (partial update). Supports all container controls: flex_direction, flex_justify_content, flex_align_items, flex_wrap, flex_align_content, gap, content_width, min_height, overflow, html_tag, container_type, grid controls, background (set background_background=classic first), border (set border_border=solid first), border_radius, box_shadow, padding, margin, position, z_index, animation, shape dividers, etc. (The unprefixed justify_content / align_items / align_content are accepted and remapped to the flex_-prefixed keys.)

settings.description: Partial settings to merge into the container.

name: elementor-mcp-update-element
description: Updates settings on any element (container or widget). Settings are merged (partial update). Works for all element types — no need to know if the target is a container or widget.

settings.description: Partial settings to merge into the element.

name: elementor-mcp-batch-update
description: Updates multiple elements in a single save operation. Each operation specifies an element_id and settings to merge. Much more efficient than calling update-element multiple times.

name: elementor-mcp-reorder-elements
description: Reorders the children of a container by providing an ordered array of element IDs. All IDs must be direct children of the specified container.

element_ids.description: Ordered array of child element IDs in the desired order.

name: elementor-mcp-move-element
description: Moves an element to a new parent container and/or position within the page tree.

target_parent_id.description: Target parent container ID. Empty string for top-level.

name: elementor-mcp-remove-element
description: Removes an element and all its children from a page.

name: elementor-mcp-duplicate-element
description: Duplicates an element (including all children) with fresh IDs. The duplicate is placed immediately after the original.

name: elementor-mcp-add-widget
description: Adds any Elementor widget to a container. Use get-widget-schema to discover the available settings for each widget type.

name: elementor-mcp-update-widget
description: Updates settings on an existing widget. Settings are merged (partial update).

name: elementor-mcp-add-heading
description: Adds a heading widget. Supports full typography (set typography_typography=custom first), text stroke, text shadow, blend mode, hover color. Also accepts responsive suffixes (align_tablet, align_mobile) and common advanced controls (_margin, _padding, _background_*, _border_*, etc). All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

name: elementor-mcp-add-text-editor
description: Adds a rich text editor widget. Supports typography (set typography_typography=custom), drop cap, text columns, and text color. Accepts responsive suffixes and advanced controls. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

drop_cap.description: Enable drop cap on first letter.

column_gap.description: Column gap: {size, unit}. Works with text_columns.

name: elementor-mcp-add-image
description: Adds an image widget. Supports width, max-width, opacity, border, border-radius, box shadow, CSS filters (brightness, contrast, saturation, hue), and hover effects. Accepts responsive suffixes and advanced controls. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

image.description: Image object with url (required) and optional id.

name: elementor-mcp-add-button
description: Adds a button widget. Supports typography (set typography_typography=custom), border, background, hover colors, box shadow, and text shadow. Accepts responsive suffixes and advanced controls. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

name: elementor-mcp-add-video
description: Adds a video widget. Supports YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, self-hosted. Options: start/end time, lazy load, privacy mode, image overlay, play icon. Accepts responsive suffixes and advanced controls. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

name: elementor-mcp-add-icon
description: Adds an icon widget. Supports Font Awesome and SVG icons, view modes (default/stacked/framed), hover colors, rotate, padding, border radius, and hover animation. For SVG, first use upload-svg-icon. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

selected_icon.description: Icon object. Font Awesome: { "value": "fas fa-star", "library": "fa-solid" }. SVG: { "value": { "id": 123, "url": "..." }, "library": "svg" }. Libraries: fa-solid, fa-regular, fa-brands.

name: elementor-mcp-add-spacer
description: Adds a spacer widget for vertical spacing between elements.

name: elementor-mcp-add-divider
description: Adds a horizontal divider/separator widget with style, weight, color, and width options.

name: elementor-mcp-add-icon-box
description: Adds an icon box widget. Supports icon position (top/left/right), title typography (set title_typography_typography=custom), description typography, icon spacing, hover colors, and hover animation. Accepts responsive suffixes and advanced controls. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

selected_icon.description: Icon object. Font Awesome: { "value": "fas fa-star", "library": "fa-solid" }. SVG: { "value": { "id": 123, "url": "..." }, "library": "svg" }.

name: elementor-mcp-add-accordion
description: Adds an accordion widget. Supports title/content colors, background, border, typography (set title_typography_typography=custom), spacing, icon color, and FAQ schema. Accepts responsive suffixes and advanced controls. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

tabs.description: Array of accordion items with tab_title and tab_content.

selected_icon.description: Icon when collapsed. Default: fas fa-plus.

selected_active_icon.description: Icon when expanded. Default: fas fa-minus.

name: elementor-mcp-add-alert
description: Adds an alert/notice widget with type, title, and description.

name: elementor-mcp-add-counter
description: Adds an animated counter widget that counts up to a number. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

name: elementor-mcp-add-google-maps
description: Adds an embedded Google Maps widget with address, zoom, and height.

name: elementor-mcp-add-icon-list
description: Adds a list widget with icons and text. Great for feature lists, checklists, and contact info.

icon_list.description: Array of list items with text, selected_icon, and optional link.

view.description: Layout: traditional (vertical) or inline. Default: traditional.

name: elementor-mcp-add-image-box
description: Adds an image box widget with image, title, and description. Great for service cards.

image.description: Image object with url and optional id.

name: elementor-mcp-add-image-carousel
description: Adds a rotating image carousel/slider widget. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

carousel.description: Array of image objects with url and optional id.

name: elementor-mcp-add-progress
description: Adds an animated progress bar widget with label and percentage.

name: elementor-mcp-add-social-icons
description: Adds social media icon links. Great for headers and footers.

social_icon_list.description: Array of social items with social_icon and link.

name: elementor-mcp-add-star-rating
description: Adds a star rating display widget.

name: elementor-mcp-add-tabs
description: Adds a tabbed content widget with horizontal or vertical layout.

tabs.description: Array of tab items with tab_title and tab_content.

name: elementor-mcp-add-testimonial
description: Adds a testimonial widget with quote, author name, job title, and image.

testimonial_image.description: Author image object with url and optional id.

name: elementor-mcp-add-toggle
description: Adds a toggle widget (multiple items can be open). Supports title/content colors, background, border, typography (set title_typography_typography=custom), spacing, and icon color. Accepts responsive suffixes and advanced controls. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

tabs.description: Array of toggle items with tab_title and tab_content.

name: elementor-mcp-add-html
description: Adds a custom HTML code widget.

name: elementor-mcp-add-menu-anchor
description: Adds a menu anchor for one-page navigation.

anchor.description: The anchor ID (used in menu links as #id).

name: elementor-mcp-add-shortcode
description: Adds a WordPress shortcode widget.

shortcode.description: The shortcode to render, e.g. [contact-form-7 id="123"].

name: elementor-mcp-add-rating
description: Adds a star/icon rating widget. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

name: elementor-mcp-add-text-path
description: Adds curved/path text widget. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

name: elementor-mcp-add-form
description: Adds an Elementor Pro form. Supports field types (text, email, textarea, url, tel, select, radio, checkbox, number, date, time, upload, acceptance, password, html, hidden, step), submit button styling, submit actions (email, redirect, webhook, mailchimp, drip, activecampaign, getresponse, convertkit, mailerlite, slack), email settings, redirect, and success/error messages. Accepts responsive suffixes and advanced controls. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

button_width.description: Full-width button. Set to "100" for full width.

name: elementor-mcp-add-posts-grid
description: Adds an Elementor Pro posts grid widget to display a grid of posts.

name: elementor-mcp-add-countdown
description: Adds a countdown timer. Supports due_date or evergreen mode, custom labels, expire actions (hide/redirect/message), and digit/label colors and typography. Accepts responsive suffixes and advanced controls. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

due_date.description: Due date in Y-m-d H:i format.

name: elementor-mcp-add-price-table
description: Adds a pricing table. Supports 16 currency symbols, sale pricing, ribbon, footer info, button CSS ID, feature icons, and style controls (header/pricing/features/footer/button/ribbon colors and typography). Accepts responsive suffixes and advanced controls. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

name: elementor-mcp-add-flip-box
description: Adds a flip box with front/back sides. Supports icon/image graphics, flip effects (flip/slide/push/zoom/fade), height, front/back background colors, title/description colors and typography. Accepts responsive suffixes and advanced controls. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

name: elementor-mcp-add-animated-headline
description: Adds an Elementor Pro animated headline with highlight or rotating text effects. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

name: elementor-mcp-add-call-to-action
description: Adds a call-to-action widget with title, description, button, and optional graphic/ribbon. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

link.description: Button link object with url key.

name: elementor-mcp-add-slides
description: Adds a full-width slides/slider. Supports heading, description, button per slide, background image/color/overlay, Ken Burns, content animation, height, navigation, autoplay, colors, typography. Accepts responsive suffixes and advanced controls. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

name: elementor-mcp-add-testimonial-carousel
description: Adds a testimonial carousel. Supports skins (default/bubble), layouts, navigation (arrows/dots), slide spacing, background/text/border colors, image size, content gap, and name/title/content typography. Accepts responsive suffixes and advanced controls. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

slides.description: Array of testimonial items with content, image, name, and title.

name: elementor-mcp-add-price-list
description: Adds a price list widget for menus, services, or product lists with title, price, and description.

price_list.description: Array of list items with title, price, item_description, image, and link.

name: elementor-mcp-add-gallery
description: Adds an advanced gallery. Supports grid/justified/masonry layouts, multiple galleries with filtering, aspect ratio, overlay effects, lightbox, lazy load, image border/radius, and hover opacity/CSS filters. Accepts responsive suffixes and advanced controls. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

gallery.description: Array of image objects with id and url.

columns.description: Number of columns. Default: 4. Responsive: columns_tablet, columns_mobile.

name: elementor-mcp-add-share-buttons
description: Adds social share buttons for sharing the current page.

share_buttons.description: Array of share buttons with button (network name) and optional text.

button.description: Network: facebook, twitter, linkedin, pinterest, reddit, etc.

name: elementor-mcp-add-table-of-contents
description: Adds an auto-generated table of contents widget based on page headings.

title.description: TOC title. Default: Table of Contents.

name: elementor-mcp-add-blockquote
description: Adds a styled blockquote widget with quote text, author, tweet button, colors, border, typography. Accepts responsive suffixes and advanced controls. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

name: elementor-mcp-add-lottie
description: Adds a Lottie animation widget. Supports triggers, loop, speed, renderer, sizing, link, viewport settings, opacity, CSS filters. Accepts responsive suffixes and advanced controls. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

name: elementor-mcp-add-hotspot
description: Adds an image hotspot widget with clickable/hoverable points. Supports tooltip settings, animations, hotspot sizing/colors, image width. Accepts responsive suffixes and advanced controls. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

image.description: Background image object with url and optional id.

name: elementor-mcp-add-nav-menu
description: Adds a WordPress navigation menu widget (Pro). All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

menu_name.description: Menu name (as registered in WP Menus).

name: elementor-mcp-add-loop-grid
description: Adds a loop grid widget that displays posts/pages/CPTs using a loop template (Pro). All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

name: elementor-mcp-add-loop-carousel
description: Adds a loop carousel widget that displays posts in a carousel using a loop template (Pro). All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

name: elementor-mcp-add-media-carousel
description: Adds a media carousel widget for images/video with multiple skins (Pro). All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

slides.description: Array of slide items with image/video.

name: elementor-mcp-add-nested-tabs
description: Adds a modern nested tabs widget where each tab content is a container (Pro). Tab content can be populated by adding child elements to the tab containers after creation. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

tabs_direction.description: Tab direction. block-start=top, block-end=bottom, inline-start=left, inline-end=right.

name: elementor-mcp-add-nested-accordion
description: Adds a modern nested accordion widget where each item content is a container (Pro). Item content can be populated by adding child elements to the item containers after creation. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

name: elementor-mcp-add-portfolio
description: Adds an Elementor Pro portfolio widget to display a filterable grid of posts or custom post types. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

posts_per_page.description: Number of posts to display. Default: 6.

show_filter_bar.description: Show category filter bar. Default: no.

show_title.description: Show post title overlay. Default: yes.

name: elementor-mcp-add-author-box
description: Adds an Elementor Pro author box widget displaying the post author's avatar, name, bio, and a link to their posts. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

author_name_tag.description: HTML tag for the author name. Default: h3.

name: elementor-mcp-add-login
description: Adds an Elementor Pro login form widget with configurable fields, labels, remember me, lost password link, and post-login redirect. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

button_text.description: Submit button label. Default: Log In.

name: elementor-mcp-add-code-highlight
description: Adds a syntax-highlighted code block widget.

name: elementor-mcp-add-reviews
description: Adds a reviews/testimonials carousel widget. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

slides_per_view.description: Number of slides visible at once. Default: 3.

name: elementor-mcp-add-off-canvas
description: Adds an off-canvas panel widget. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

name: elementor-mcp-add-progress-tracker
description: Adds a scroll progress tracker widget.

circular_size.description: Circle diameter in pixels (circular type). Default: 200.

circular_width.description: Circle stroke width in pixels (circular type). Default: 8.

name: elementor-mcp-add-search
description: Adds a search widget with live results support. All other settings pass through; get-widget-schema for the full list.

search_input_placeholder_text.description: Placeholder text for the search input. Default: Search...

live_results.description: Enable live search results dropdown. Default: no.

name: elementor-mcp-save-as-template
description: Saves a page or a specific element as a reusable Elementor template.

element_id.description: Specific element ID to save. Omit to save the entire page.

name: elementor-mcp-apply-template
description: Applies a saved Elementor template to a page at a given position, inserting its elements with fresh IDs.

template_id.description: The template post ID to apply.

parent_id.description: Parent container ID. Empty for top-level.

name: elementor-mcp-create-theme-template
description: Creates a new Elementor Pro theme builder template (header, footer, single, archive, 404, etc.).

name: elementor-mcp-set-template-conditions
description: Sets display conditions for a theme builder template (e.g., Entire Site, specific pages, post types).

conditions.description: Array of condition rules. Each is an array like ["include", "general"] for Entire Site, or ["include", "singular", "post"] for all posts.

name: elementor-mcp-list-dynamic-tags
description: Lists all available Elementor Pro dynamic tags with their names, groups, and categories.

group.description: Filter by tag group (e.g., "post", "site", "author", "media", "action", "woocommerce"). Omit for all.

name: elementor-mcp-set-dynamic-tag
description: Sets a dynamic tag on a specific setting of an element. This makes the setting value dynamic (e.g., title becomes post title).

setting_key.description: The setting key to make dynamic (e.g., "title", "url", "image").

tag_settings.description: Optional settings for the dynamic tag.

name: elementor-mcp-create-popup
description: Creates a new Elementor Pro popup template.

name: elementor-mcp-set-popup-settings
description: Configures popup triggers, timing, and display conditions for an Elementor Pro popup.

triggers.description: Trigger settings: { "on_page_load": {"enabled": true, "delay": 3}, "on_scroll": {"enabled": true, "direction": "down", "offset": 50}, "on_click": {"enabled": true, "times": 1}, "on_exit_intent": {"enabled": true}, "on_inactivity": {"enabled": true, "time": 30} }.

conditions.description: Display conditions, same format as set-template-conditions.

name: elementor-mcp-update-global-colors
description: Updates the site-wide color palette in the Elementor kit. Provide an array of color objects with id, title, and color (hex).

name: elementor-mcp-update-global-typography
description: Updates the site-wide typography settings in the Elementor kit.

typography_font_size.description: Font size with size and unit.

typography_line_height.description: Line height with size and unit.

typography_letter_spacing.description: Letter spacing with size and unit.

name: elementor-mcp-build-page
description: Creates a complete Elementor page from a declarative structure in a single call. Supports nested containers and any widget types. IMPORTANT LAYOUT RULES: (1) For side-by-side columns, use a parent container with flex_direction=row — children are auto-set to content_width=full with equal percentage widths (e.g. 2 children = 50%, 3 = 33.33%). (2) NEVER set flex_wrap or _flex_size in settings — these cause layout overflow. The tool handles layout automatically. (3) Background colors: set background_background=classic and background_color=#hex on containers. (4) Background images: set background_background=classic, background_image={url,id}, background_size=cover. (5) Background overlay: background_overlay_background=classic, background_overlay_color=#hex, background_overlay_opacity={size:0.7,unit:px}. (6) Text alignment: text_align on text/heading widgets. (7) Use search-images and sideload-image tools to get real images before building.

structure.description: Declarative element tree. Each item has type (container|widget), settings, and optionally children (for containers) or widget_type (for widgets).

name: elementor-mcp-search-images
description: Searches Openverse (WordPress.org) for Creative Commons licensed images. Returns image URLs, thumbnails, licensing info, and attribution. Use the returned URLs with sideload-image or add-stock-image.

license.description: Filter by Creative Commons license type.

aspect_ratio.description: Filter by aspect ratio. Use "wide" for landscape images (recommended for hero banners, cards, and most page layouts). Use "tall" for portrait/sidebar images. Use "square" for avatars and thumbnails.

name: elementor-mcp-sideload-image
description: Downloads an external image URL into the WordPress Media Library and returns the local attachment ID and URL. Use this after search-images to import a chosen image.

url.description: The external image URL to download.

title.description: Attachment title. Falls back to the filename.

attribution.description: Attribution text for Creative Commons images. Stored as the attachment caption/excerpt.

name: elementor-mcp-add-stock-image
description: Searches Openverse for an image, downloads it to the Media Library, and adds it as an image widget to the page — all in one step. Defaults to landscape (wide) images for consistent layouts. Combines search-images + sideload-image + add-image.

query.description: Image search keywords (e.g. "hero banner technology", "team photo office").

index.description: Which search result to use (0 = best match). Default: 0.

caption.description: Caption override. Defaults to Openverse attribution.

aspect_ratio.description: Image aspect ratio filter. Default: wide (landscape). Use "wide" for hero banners and card images, "tall" for sidebar/portrait, "square" for thumbnails, "any" for no filter.

alt_text.description: Alt text override. Defaults to the image title.

name: elementor-mcp-list-media
description: Lists and searches images already in the WordPress Media Library. Use this to find a site's own uploaded photos (e.g. a client's product or job-site images) before reaching for Openverse stock. The optional "search" matches the title, alt text, caption, and description. Returns attachment IDs and URLs you can pass straight to add-image / add-widget.

search.description: Keyword to match against the attachment title, alt text, caption, and description. Omit to list everything.

mime_type.description: MIME type filter. Accepts a top-level type ("image") or a specific type ("image/jpeg", "image/png"). Use "any" for all media types. Default: image.

name: elementor-mcp-upload-svg-icon
description: Uploads an SVG icon to the WordPress Media Library and returns an Elementor icon object ready to use with any widget that accepts icons (icon, icon-box, button, etc.). Accepts either an external SVG URL or raw SVG markup. The returned icon object has the format: { "value": { "id": 123, "url": "..." }, "library": "svg" }. Use this value for the selected_icon setting in icon/icon-box widgets, or the selected_icon setting in button widgets.

svg_url.description: External URL to an SVG file to download and import. Use this OR svg_content, not both.

svg_content.description: Raw SVG markup string (e.g. "<svg viewBox='0 0 24 24'><path d='M12 ...'/></svg>"). Use this OR svg_url, not both.

title.description: Title for the SVG in the Media Library. Falls back to filename or "Custom SVG Icon".

name: elementor-mcp-add-custom-js
description: Adds a custom JavaScript snippet to a page by inserting an HTML widget containing a <script> tag. Works with free Elementor (no Pro required). The JS code is automatically wrapped in <script> tags — do NOT include them yourself. Use wrap_dom_ready=true to wrap in a DOMContentLoaded listener. For site-wide JS, use add-code-snippet instead (requires Pro).

js.description: JavaScript code to inject. Do NOT include <script> tags — they are added automatically.

wrap_dom_ready.description: Wrap the code in a DOMContentLoaded listener. Default: false.

name: elementor-mcp-add-custom-css
description: Adds custom CSS to a specific element or to the entire page. Requires Elementor Pro. For element-level CSS, use the keyword "selector" as a placeholder for the element's CSS wrapper (e.g. "selector .heading { color: red; }" or "selector:hover { transform: scale(1.05); }"). For page-level CSS, omit element_id. Appends to existing CSS by default; set replace=true to overwrite.

element_id.description: Optional element ID to apply CSS to. If omitted, CSS is applied at the page level.

css.description: CSS rules to add. Use "selector" as the element wrapper placeholder for element-level CSS.

replace.description: If true, replaces existing custom CSS instead of appending. Default: false.

name: elementor-mcp-add-code-snippet
description: Creates a site-wide Custom Code snippet using Elementor Pro. Injects CSS or JavaScript into the <head>, after <body> open, or before </body> close on ALL pages. Use this for analytics scripts, site-wide CSS overrides, meta tags, or tracking pixels. Requires Elementor Pro and manage_options capability.

title.description: Descriptive title for the snippet (e.g. "Google Analytics", "Global CSS overrides").

code.description: The full code to inject. Include <script>, <style>, or <meta> tags as needed.

location.description: Where to inject: "head" = <head> tag, "body_start" = after <body>, "body_end" = before </body>. Default: head.

priority.description: Load order priority (1-10, lower = earlier). Default: 1.

status.description: Post status. "publish" = active immediately. "draft" = saved but not active. Default: publish.

ensure_jquery.description: If true, ensures jQuery is loaded before this snippet runs. Default: false.

name: elementor-mcp-list-code-snippets
description: Lists all existing Elementor Pro Custom Code snippets with their titles, locations, priorities, and statuses. Requires Elementor Pro.

status.description: Filter by post status. Default: any.

name: elementor-mcp-add-atomic-widget
description: Adds any Elementor 4.0+ atomic widget to a container. Settings must use the $$type prop format. For simpler usage, prefer the convenience tools (add-atomic-heading, etc.).

widget_type.description: Atomic widget type name (e.g. e-heading, e-button).

name: elementor-mcp-update-atomic-widget
description: Updates settings on an existing Elementor 4.0+ atomic widget. Performs a partial merge — only provided keys are changed.

name: elementor-mcp-add-atomic-heading
description: Adds an Elementor 4.0 atomic heading element. Accepts plain text and tag; $$type wrapping is handled automatically.

parent_id.description: Parent container element ID (e-flexbox or e-div-block).

link.description: Optional URL to link the heading.

css_id.description: Optional CSS ID for the element.

name: elementor-mcp-add-atomic-paragraph
description: Adds an Elementor 4.0 atomic paragraph element.

parent_id.description: Parent container element ID (e-flexbox or e-div-block).

link.description: Optional URL to link the paragraph.

name: elementor-mcp-add-atomic-button
description: Adds an Elementor 4.0 atomic button element.

parent_id.description: Parent container element ID (e-flexbox or e-div-block).

name: elementor-mcp-add-atomic-image
description: Adds an Elementor 4.0 atomic image element. Provide either image_id (from media library) or image_url.

parent_id.description: Parent container element ID (e-flexbox or e-div-block).

image_url.description: Image URL (if not using media library).

name: elementor-mcp-add-atomic-svg
description: Adds an Elementor 4.0 atomic SVG element.

parent_id.description: Parent container element ID (e-flexbox or e-div-block).

svg_id.description: WordPress media library SVG attachment ID.

svg_url.description: SVG URL (if not using media library).

name: elementor-mcp-add-atomic-youtube
description: Adds an Elementor 4.0 atomic YouTube video element.

parent_id.description: Parent container element ID (e-flexbox or e-div-block).

name: elementor-mcp-add-atomic-video
description: Adds an Elementor 4.0 atomic self-hosted video element.

parent_id.description: Parent container element ID (e-flexbox or e-div-block).

name: elementor-mcp-add-atomic-divider
description: Adds an Elementor 4.0 atomic divider element.

parent_id.description: Parent container element ID (e-flexbox or e-div-block).

name: elementor-mcp-add-flexbox
description: Adds an Elementor 4.0 flexbox container. Layout properties (direction, justify, align, gap) are applied as local styles automatically. Use this instead of add-container for Elementor 4.0+ sites.

parent_id.description: Parent element ID. Empty for top-level.

padding.description: Padding on all sides (px by default).

name: elementor-mcp-add-div-block
description: Adds an Elementor 4.0 div-block container (block flow layout). Use for non-flex containers.

parent_id.description: Parent element ID. Empty for top-level.

padding.description: Padding on all sides (px by default).

name: elementor-mcp-detect-elementor-version
description: Returns the Elementor version and whether atomic elements (v4.0+) are supported. Call this first to decide whether to use legacy tools (add-heading, add-container) or atomic tools (add-atomic-heading, add-flexbox).

name: elementor-mcp-list-global-classes
description: Resolves Elementor Class Manager (Global Classes) entries. Maps the opaque "g-" class IDs that appear on elements back to their human-readable names and the CSS properties they define, per breakpoint/state. Use it to understand what styling a g- class applies. Pass class_ids to resolve specific IDs, or omit to list them all. Read-only.

class_ids.description: Optional list of g- class IDs to resolve (e.g. ["g-037bb9c"]). Omit to return every global class.
